_comment: Callables that App Store builds already in users' hands depend on.
Removing or renaming any of these breaks the live app for anyone who
hasn't updated — an outage no rollback of the *app* can fix, because
old binaries stay on devices forever.
deploy-guarded.sh FAILS the deploy if any name here disappears from
functions/src/index.ts. Adding new callables is always safe.
When a release stops supporting an old callable, remove it here FIRST,
in a commit that explains which app versions are being dropped.
